question: top pickup zones by high-fare trip count
sql:
WITH zone_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    PULocationID,
    list({do: DOLocationID, fare: fare_amount, dist: trip_distance}) AS trips
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  WHERE fare_amount > 0 AND trip_distance > 0
  GROUP BY PULocationID
)
SELECT 
  PULocationID,
  len(trips) AS total_trips,
  len(list_filter(trips, x -> x.fare > 50)) AS high_fare_count
FROM zone_trips
WHERE len(list_filter(trips, x -> x.fare > 50)) > 0
ORDER BY high_fare_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: busiest pickup-dropoff zone pairs
sql:
WITH pair_lists AS (
  SELECT 
    PULocationID AS pu,
    list({do: DOLocationID, fare: fare_amount, dist: trip_distance, pax: passenger_count}) AS trips
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  WHERE fare_amount > 0 AND trip_distance > 0
  GROUP BY PULocationID
)
SELECT 
  pu,
  t.do,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  ROUND(AVG(t.fare), 2) AS avg_fare
FROM pair_lists, UNNEST(trips) AS t(do, fare, dist, pax)
GROUP BY pu, t.do
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: trips with highest total as nested json
sql:
SELECT 
  PULocationID,
  DOLocationID,
  json_extract_string(j, '$.charges.fare') AS fare,
  json_extract_string(j, '$.charges.tip') AS tip
FROM (
  SELECT 
    PULocationID,
    DOLocationID,
    to_json({
      charges: {fare: fare_amount, tip: tip_amount, tolls: tolls_amount},
      trip: {dist: trip_distance, pax: passenger_count}
    }) AS j
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  WHERE total_amount > 100
)
ORDER BY CAST(json_extract_string(j, '$.charges.fare') AS DOUBLE) DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: pickup zones with largest tip amounts
sql:
WITH zone_data AS (
  SELECT 
    PULocationID,
    list({
      do: DOLocationID,
      charges: struct_pack(fare := fare_amount, tip := tip_amount, tolls := tolls_amount, surcharge := improvement_surcharge)
    }) AS trips
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  WHERE total_amount > 0
  GROUP BY PULocationID
)
SELECT 
  PULocationID,
  len(trips) AS total,
  len(list_filter(trips, x -> x.charges.tip > 10)) AS big_tip_count,
  ROUND(list_avg(list_transform(trips, x -> x.charges.tip)), 2) AS avg_tip
FROM zone_data
WHERE len(list_filter(trips, x -> x.charges.tip > 10)) > 0
ORDER BY avg_tip DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: pickup zones sharing dropoff zones
sql:
WITH zone_dropoffs AS (
  SELECT 
    PULocationID,
    list_sort(list_distinct(list(DOLocationID))) AS dropoffs
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY PULocationID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DOLocationID) >= 5
),
top_zones AS (
  SELECT * FROM zone_dropoffs ORDER BY len(dropoffs) DESC LIMIT 50
)
SELECT 
  a.PULocationID AS zone_a,
  b.PULocationID AS zone_b,
  len(list_intersect(a.dropoffs, b.dropoffs)) AS shared_count
FROM top_zones a
JOIN top_zones b ON a.PULocationID < b.PULocationID
WHERE len(list_intersect(a.dropoffs, b.dropoffs)) >= 3
ORDER BY shared_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: pickup zones with peak evening rush trips
sql:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT 
    PULocationID,
    list({hr: EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime), fare: fare_amount}) AS trips
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  WHERE fare_amount > 0
  GROUP BY PULocationID
)
SELECT 
  PULocationID,
  len(trips) AS total_trips,
  list_sort(list_distinct(list_transform(trips, x -> x.hr))) AS active_hours,
  len(list_filter(trips, x -> x.hr BETWEEN 17 AND 19)) AS evening_rush
FROM hourly
WHERE len(list_filter(trips, x -> x.hr BETWEEN 17 AND 19)) > 0
ORDER BY evening_rush DESC
LIMIT 10;
